title: Exploration the mechanism of Shenling Baizhu San in the treatment of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease based on UPLC-Q-TOF-MS/MS, network pharmacology and in vitro experimental verification.
authors: Gao, Zu; Wang, Jiayun; Lu, Guangying; Wu, Qiaolan; Wang, Shijun; Wu, Xiaolin; Ou, Chunxue; Wu, Zhichun; Yu, Huayun; Wang, Yuan
one_liner_zh: 该文基于UPLC-Q-TOF-MS/MS、网络药理学和体外实验研究参苓白术散治疗慢阻肺的机制，虽含分子对接但对象为中药成分与炎症靶点，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Shenling Baizhu San (SLBZS) is a formula of traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) that enhances the functions of the qi, spleen, and lung. According to the theory of TCM, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) is often caused by lung qi deficiency, and SLBZS is often used in the treatment of COPD and has achieved remarkable results. However, the active components of SLBZS absorbed in serum and the underlying mechanism of SLBZS in treating COPD remain unclear and require further studies. AIM OF THE STUDY: The objective of this study is to investigate the active components of SLBZS in rat serum, as well as the crucial targets and signaling pathways involved in the therapeutic effects of SLBZS for COPD. MATERIALS AND METHODS: First, the absorption components and metabolites of SLBZS in rat serum were identified using ultra-performance liquid chromatography-quadrupole time-of-flight tandem mass spectrometry (UPLC-Q-TOF-MS/MS). Second, potential targets of SLBZS for the treatment of COPD were acquired from publicly accessible online sources. Cytoscape (v3.7.0) software was used to construct a component-target-pathway network and a protein-protein interaction (PPI) network. The Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG) analysis of potential targets was performed using the Metascape database. The binding status of the active components in SLBZS to the potential targets was assessed with molecular docking technology. Finally, a cell model of COPD was successfully developed for experimental validation In vitro. RESULTS: A total of 108 active components were identified, including 30 prototype components and 78 metabolites. A total of 292 potential targets for the treatment of COPD were identified, including TNF, IL-6, TLR9, RELA, and others. The KEGG pathway included inflammatory mediator regulation of TRP channels, necroptosis, and the NF-kappaB signaling pathway, among others. The In vitro experiments showed that SLBZS-containing serum had the ability to decrease the levels of inflammatory factors and cell death. Additionally, it was observed that SLBZS-containing serum could control the expression levels of TLR9, MyD88, TRAF6, NF-kappaB, and IkappaBalpha at the mRNA and protein levels. These findings suggested that SLBZS-containing serum was likely to be involved in the regulation of the TLR9/NF-kappaB pathway. CONCLUSIONS: The mechanism of action of SLBZS on COPD was preliminarily elucidated using UPLC-Q-TOF-MS/MS, network pharmacology, and In vitro experiments. The primary active components and potential targets of SLBZS were identified, providing a scientific foundation for further research.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：参苓白术散（SLBZS）是一种中药方剂，能增强气、脾和肺的功能。根据中医理论，慢性阻塞性肺疾病（COPD）常由肺气虚引起，SLBZS常用于治疗COPD并取得了显著疗效。然而，SLBZS在血清中吸收的活性成分及其治疗COPD的潜在机制仍不清楚，需要进一步研究。研究目的：本研究旨在探讨SLBZS在大鼠血清中的活性成分，以及SLBZS治疗COPD所涉及的关键靶点和信号通路。材料与方法：首先，采用超高效液相色谱-四极杆飞行时间串联质谱（UPLC-Q-TOF-MS/MS）鉴定SLBZS在大鼠血清中的吸收成分和代谢物。其次，从公开可访问的在线来源获取SLBZS治疗COPD的潜在靶点。使用Cytoscape（v3.7.0）软件构建成分-靶点-通路网络和蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）网络。利用Metascape数据库对潜在靶点进行京都基因与基因组百科全书（KEGG）分析。通过分子对接技术评估SLBZS中活性成分与潜在靶点的结合状态。最后，成功建立COPD细胞模型用于体外实验验证。结果：共鉴定出108种活性成分，包括30种原型成分和78种代谢物。共识别出292个治疗COPD的潜在靶点，包括TNF、IL-6、TLR9、RELA等。KEGG通路包括炎症介质对TRP通道的调节、坏死性凋亡和NF-kappaB信号通路等。体外实验表明，含SLBZS血清能够降低炎症因子水平和细胞死亡。此外，观察到含SLBZS血清能够在mRNA和蛋白质水平上控制TLR9、MyD88、TRAF6、NF-kappaB和IkappaBalpha的表达水平。这些发现表明，含SLBZS血清可能参与调节TLR9/NF-kappaB通路。结论：通过UPLC-Q-TOF-MS/MS、网络药理学和体外实验，初步阐明了SLBZS对COPD的作用机制。鉴定了SLBZS的主要活性成分和潜在靶点，为进一步研究提供了科学基础。
